scope: Read-only OpenSpec speech stability plan review; implementation review pending

assessment.rootCause: Both original simulator incidents terminate at Swift executor enforcement in SpeechInputModel.start authorization callback on a default background queue. Proposed explicit nonisolated Sendable factories address this boundary without disabling checks.
assessment.coverage: Plan includes background callback dispatch, permission cancellation, stale generation events, resource ownership, interruption/background/navigation and editable keyboard fallback.
assessment.boundedRun: Fresh scoped state with three executions per check, two identical no-progress failures and forty minutes active commands is suitable for native units, scoped speech UI and existing launch checks; prior states preserved.
assessment.nativeUILimit: Public simulator/XCUI permission reset supports microphone; denied microphone will be actual UI, denied speech controlled production-model unit test. Real first-use speech authorization alert should be accepted if present. Report these scopes separately.
assessment.acceptance: Recognition-unavailable fallback is acceptable on simulator only if original input stays editable and sendable; success is not fabricated and physical-device transcription is excluded.
assessment.secondCrash: Actual real granted-permission testing revealed independent native audio-service timeout; revised design records original failure, setup/lifecycle hardening and environment-specific repair without expanding acceptance to Bluetooth or physical devices.

implementationReviewFocus: Ensure old pending-start defer cannot clear a newer generation state after cancel/restart.
Exercise actual production callback factories on background queues, including audio tap bridge, rather than only mocked model events.
Permission alert inactive scene phase must not cancel first-use request; background and navigation must cancel.
Release only owned audio resources and preserve accepted partial text on failure/interruption.

secondRoundAssessment.pendingInputPreservation: Chat input now disables for speech.isActive including pending authorization. Cancellation remains available; native UI verifies pending starting state and disabled editor at actual microphone alert. This resolves first review P2.
secondRoundAssessment.backgroundNotificationTransfer: Interruption test constructs legacy non-Sendable Notification on background queue from Sendable integer case; captured cross-queue payload is no longer Notification.
secondRoundAssessment.nativeAudioHardening: Backend uses playAndRecord/measurement/defaultToSpeaker, validates activated input availability/sample rate/channel count before engine.inputNode, caches acquired input node and removes tap through cached reference during stop. Existing failure cleanup is reached for throwing setup failures.
secondRoundAssessment.newCrashScope: Original granted-permission UI failure is distinct SIGABRT at _ReportRPCTimeout/AURemoteIO.Initialize/inputNode. App hardening plus explicit builtin Simulator audio routing and reboot is within current plan. No universal AudioUnit fatal-timeout recovery is claimed.
secondRoundAssessment.runIntegrity: First failed real UI run retained. Same corrected runner state and same original attempt/active-command limits reused after repair, according to requested execution context; final state/provenance acceptance deferred to evidence review.
secondRoundAssessment.evidenceAcceptance: This PASS is planning/implementation acceptance only. Current second runner execution must finish before final tests and original attachments are independently accepted.
